label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from request parameter flows directly into SQL query string without proper escaping or parameterization. The Base64 encode/decode cycle in doSomething() is effectively a no-op (identity transformation) and does not sanitize the input. The SQL concatenation at line 71 allows arbitrary user input to reach the JDBC template query, enabling SQL injection attacks.

evidence.note: User input extracted from request parameter map into param variable
doSomething performs Base64 encode/decode which is identity operation - no actual sanitization occurs
SQL query constructed via string concatenation with unsanitized user input bar
